===== 2026-01-01 00:00:00 | cmd=help feeding | room=10422
[1090 ] FEEDING
Last Updated [Tue Dec 17 21:30:00 2024]
*Combat proficiency (1% complexity)
*(No Specific Target) target, 1 second usage time
*Cooldown: 60 seconds (2 uses triggers)
*Classes granted this proficiency: (No player classes)
*Races granted this proficiency: Sahuagin, Fey
*Races afflicted by this proficiency: (No player races)
*Deals pierce/pierce (2.5 base) damage.
*Skill Power: Every point of skill power correlates to 2% damage when feeding from a panicked target.
*This proficiency is short ranged.
*'feeding' is available for practice from the shop: 'Beardstratis' Basic Training - Lasler'.
*'feeding' is available for practice from the shop: 'Basic Combat Training'.
*'feeding' is available for practice from the shop: 'a Devious Fey's Faerie Skills - Unseelie Castle'.
*'feeding' is available for practice from the shop: 'a Faerie's Basic Skills - Lasler'.
*'feeding' is available for practice from the shop: 'a Long-Finned Battlemaster's Meditations - Darksea'.

NAME
feed - use special vampiric attack (Sahuagin and Fey only)

SYNOPSIS
feed [<victim name>]

DESCRIPTION
Feed is the command Fey and Sahuagin may use to attack their victims with
their teeth.
 
Feys may feed when not in combat, and if sneaking or shifted will gain a
bonus to feed accuracy, via cunning strike. If the victim is wearing an
item that is bane to feys or vampires, it will ward off the attack. 

Depending on the reaction the victim has to the feeding, they may become
paralyzed for a brief period of time.

Fey may also drink the spilled blood that remains from a recent fight by
using the 'FEED' command with no arguments in the location containing the
blood.
 
Sahuagin may only feed during combat and not frequently, as they require a
cooldown period in order to digest the victim's flesh.  They also react
very strongly to the scent of blood in the water and if one sahuagin feeds
on a victim, any other sahuagin will go into a feeding frenzy and bite
the target as well.


SEE ALSO:
 [2183] exodontia - makes the victim think their teeth have fallen out
 [1058] shift - transform into the appearance of another creature
 [1983] cunning strike - a lingering accuracy-boosting after-effect of using certain proficiencies
 [1136] drink - drink from a container or fountain, drink a potion
 eat - nourish your character with food or a pill
 fill - fill an empty container or lamp with liquid
 empty - empties a container filled with liquid
 [2151] hemophage - fills its target with bloodlust, dealing more damage when feeding
 [2074] imbalance - permits a combatant to be caught off guard and attacked in unusual ways
 [2102] viper strike - boosts weapon damage by feeding-damage
 [1976] blood dance - surrounds the caster with flying blades, spilling blood on the
 ground periodically during combat
 [2287] lingering anti-paralytic - prevents the target from being paralyzed again
lingering antimagic - prevents the target from being dispelled again

===== 2026-01-01 00:00:00 | cmd=help lightning pursuit | room=10422
[2481 ] LIGHTNING PURSUIT
Last Updated [Mon Feb 23 13:46:09 2026]
*Physiomancy spell (25% complexity)
*Character (Offensive) target, 2 second cast time
*Classes granted this spell: Monk
*Races granted this spell: (No player races)
*Races afflicted by this spell: Primate
*Costs 1.9 practices per percent learned.
*Tags: Buff
*Spell Points Required: 77
*When you lightning pursuit, you will apply -6 distance for 5 minutes]
*When you lightning pursuit, you will apply -3 agility for 5 minutes]
*This will apply 0 lightning-damage to the caster based on your skillpower.
*Checks against lightning, none, none.
*Consumes 4 air reagents, 1 runestone reagent, 2 ethereal reagents when cast.
*This spell's affect cannot be dispelled.
*'lightning pursuit' is available for practice from the shop: 'The Ranger's Informational Handbook'.

NAME
lightning pursuit - close the distance between you and an opponent, reducing your distance from them

SYNOPSIS
cast 'lightning pursuit' <opponent>

DESCRIPTION
The heat of battle can cool off quickly when cowards retreat from the 
battlefield, so the easiest way to maintain the fight's tempo is with lightning
quick reflexes. When taking advantage of their lightning pursuit, fighters will
reduce the distance between themselves and their opponent, decreasing their 
ability to kite the caster around and outranging them.


SEE ALSO:
 [2482] take flight -  take to the skies, decreasing your proximity to the heat of battle

  This is the Runic Temple, a large and impressive white marble building.

is a marble archway to the west that leads to other areas of the temple,
such as the Tourist Center, Donation Room and Health Center.  The archway to
the east leads to the beautiful Garden of Life.
